fields.v: Evaluation flow: fresh container and workspace (LLVM 14, ANTLR, pybind11, CMake) -> agent executes T0 env setup, T1 lexer, T2 parser, T3 IR generation, T4 IR optimization, T5 RV64 assembly sequentially in one persistent repository -> per-task deterministic test suites (0-100) -> Mode 1: resurrection (golden artifact injected when score < threshold, e.g. 60%, agent not informed) or Mode 2: no resurrection (cascading failures); max 500 dialogue turns across the pipeline

(5) + Qwen-3.6-Max: 100/100/100/65.8/35.0/0.0, 56.72, $67.28, AEI 66.75. (6) + Kimi-2.5: 100/100/14.2/24.7/39.7/9.4, 40.24, $1.75. (7) + Kimi-2.6: 100/95.9/31.4/1.4/37.5/0.0, 33.94, $3.99. (8) + GLM-4.6: 100/67.4/38.5/1.4/39.6/0.0, 30.88, cost not reported. (9) + DS-Chat: 100/72.9/30.9/0.0/35.7/0.0, 29.74, $0.07, AEI 60.36. (10) + Qwen-3.5-Plus: 100/100/0.0/0.0/38.0/0.0, 29.63, $14.37. (11) + GLM-4.7: 100/94.8/0.0/1.4/36.2/0.0, 29.50, $0.80. (12) + GLM-5.1: 100/0.0/97.7/0.0/36.6/0.0, 27.26, $2.03. (13) + Qwen3-Coder: 100/56.0/20.6/1.4/35.1/0.0, 25.97, $0.05, AEI 64.22, 608.36 s, 3.48M tokens. (14) + MiniMax-2.5: 100/64.2/0.0/2.7/36.4/0.0, 25.09, $0.17. Quality verdict against the authors' end-to-end criterion (a tier is reached only if every task up to it is correctly and completely accomplished; completion = score 100): does not work for all 15 agent configurations (none completes T0-T5) and does not work for the baseline. Note: the authors also name a per-task passing threshold of 60 (bold in Table 4, resurrection trigger); under that threshold Opus-4.7 passes all six tasks. Cost verdict: no criterion stated by the authors (all configurations; N/A for the baseline)

fields.v: Opus-4.7 highest MR (93.39) but highest cost ($126.24, 14.5x DS-v4-Pro for a 9.4% MR gain); DS-v4-Pro second (85.34, $8.68); GPT-5.5 highest AEI (81.57, MR 65.91). Cost range $0.05-$126.24 (2,525x). Stage completion rates 100% (T0), 46.7% (T1), 26.7% (T2), 13.3% (T3), 0% (T4), 20% (T5); average MR 42.7, reported as 17.6 points above the non-agent baseline. Context failure most frequent hard-stop cause (9 of 15), planning failure 2, reasoning failure 1; planning failure observed in 8 of 15. OLS: cost explains about 52% and time about 40% of MR variance. No significance tests

GLM-4.6 cost not reported. Repository and leaderboard said to be open-sourced (ramp.yatcc-ai.com; YatCC on GitHub, arcsysu/YatCC). Footnote: results of extra backends to be added. No pre-registration. Programming language: implementation language not stated (toolchain LLVM 14, ANTLR, pybind11, CMake); the compiler input is C source code
